customManagers.description: Bun is pinned per job in the workflows; nothing else tracks it, so a stale pin silently changes lockfile resolution and --frozen-lockfile behaviour in CI.

SwiftLint is pinned with a SHA-256 in the setup-swiftlint composite action. Bumping the tag without recomputing the checksum fails closed, so every PR from this manager carries the recompute command in its body.

packageRules.description: JS/TS non-breaking updates land as one weekly PR. The workspace is a bun + Turborepo monorepo, so per-package PRs would be dozens of near-identical runs of the same gate set.
Major JS/TS bumps stay one PR per dependency: they change public API surface of the runtime, navigation or vite plugin and need review, not batching.
Docs site and the 17 example apps are not published artifacts. Batch them so they cannot crowd out framework PRs.

Vue is not a normal dependency here: package.json > vueNative.vueCohort is the single source of truth, scripts/set-vue-cohort.mjs rewrites the tree from it, and check:vue-cohort is a CI gate. A blind bump desyncs the cohort contract, so it needs explicit approval.
prBodyNotes: ### Vue cohort coupling
This repo pins Vue through `package.json > vueNative.vueCohort` (`active` + `next`), not through a normal dependency range.
Before merging: run `bun run vue:cohort:set <version>` (or `bun run check:vue-cohort`) so every workspace stays on one Vue copy, then re-run `bun run check:ts`.
A second Vue instance means a second reactivity system, which breaks the custom renderer.

packageRules.description: Android native dependencies. Every bump needs the full native gate set (compileDebugKotlin, assembleRelease, both unit-test tasks, ktlint) plus device re-verification per AGENTS.md, so Renovate must not open these unprompted.
prBodyNotes: ### Native re-verification required
Run the Android gates before merging:
- `cd native/android && ./gradlew :VueNativeCore:ktlintCheck`
- `cd native/android && ./gradlew :VueNativeCore:compileDebugKotlin :VueNativeCore:assembleRelease`
- `cd native/android && ./gradlew :VueNativeCore:testDebugUnitTest :VueNativeCore:testReleaseUnitTest`
- `bun run smoke:app-shell -- --require=android.host`
AGENTS.md also expects a physical-device pass for camera capture and biometric auth.

packageRules.description: Major Android toolchain bumps are individually large migrations (AGP and Gradle are coupled, and compileSdk cannot move before AGP does). Keep them separate and approval-gated.
prBodyNotes: ### Coupled toolchain
`native/android/gradle.properties` sets `android.suppressUnsupportedCompileSdk=35` because the pinned AGP does not officially support `compileSdk` 35.
Raising `compileSdk` requires bumping AGP first, and AGP requires a matching Gradle version. Move them together and remove the suppression flag once AGP supports the SDK natively.
CameraX is pinned to 1.4.2 for the same reason: 1.5.x/1.6.x need compileSdk 36 and AGP 8.9+.

packageRules.description: J2V8 is the V8 engine under the whole Android bridge and is pinned in a build script rather than the version catalog. Upgrading swaps the bundled native library for every host app.
prBodyNotes: ### J2V8 is the Android JS engine
This AAR bundles the native V8 library that runs the whole bridge on Android.
It is deliberately outside `gradle/libs.versions.toml`; see the comment next to the dependency in `native/android/VueNativeCore/build.gradle.kts`.

Verify: 16 KB page alignment (Play requirement for apps targeting Android 15+), `abiFilters` coverage, and a physical-device pass of the bridge plus `bun run smoke:app-shell -- --require=android.host`.
Also confirm the artifact still resolves: JitPack sits in the Android repository list.

packageRules.description: Swift packages (iOS, macOS, shared, root consumer-facing Package.swift). Same rule as Android: a bump needs the xcodebuild and swift test gates re-run on a real simulator.
prBodyNotes: ### Native re-verification required
Run every affected Swift gate before merging:
- `cd native/shared/VueNativeShared && swift build && swift test`
- `cd native/macos/VueNativeMacOS && swift build && swift test`
- `cd native/ios/VueNativeCore && xcodebuild build -scheme VueNativeCore -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17,OS=latest'` and the matching `xcodebuild test`
- `bun run smoke:app-shell -- --require=ios.simulator,macos.host`
The root `Package.swift` is the consumer-facing SPM entry point, so a dependency change there is a public API change.

packageRules.description: Workflow action bumps in one weekly PR. helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests additionally converts tag references to commit SHAs, which is the supply-chain posture the publish workflow already assumes (OIDC, no registry token).
CI toolchain pins discovered by the regex managers (Bun version in the workflows, pinned SwiftLint in the composite action).
prBodyNotes: ### SwiftLint checksum
If this PR touches `.github/actions/setup-swiftlint/action.yml`, the `sha256` input must be recomputed for the new tag or the action fails closed:
```bash
curl -fsSL -o /tmp/sl.zip https://github.com/realm/SwiftLint/releases/download/<TAG>/portable_swiftlint.zip
shasum -a 256 /tmp/sl.zip
If it touches the `bun-version` pins, every workflow must move together so CI and the release gate resolve the same lockfile.
